llm.evidence: The HPLC system was coupled to an OrbiTrap QExactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc)
We performed quantification based on protein intensities.
dehydrated samples were digested in 12.5 ng/ml Trypsin Gold (Promega)
After trap enrichment, peptides were eluted in a PepMap C18 nanocolumn
fragmented by collision induced dissociation (normalized collision energy 35% and resolution of 17,500)
50 mM iodoacetamide was added for 30 min and incubated in the dark for alkylation
